[[J2–J3 100 Year Vision League|2026 J2–J3]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 J2 League|2027–28]] | updated = 11 October 2026 }} The '''2026–27 J2 League''', also known as the {{Nihongo|'''2026/27 [[Meiji Yasuda Life|Meiji Yasuda]] [[J2 League]]'''|2026/27シーズン 明治安田J2リーグ|2026/27 Shīzun Meiji Yasuda J2 Rīgu|lead=yes}} for sponsorship reasons, is the 28th season of the [[J2 League]], the second-tier Japanese professional league for association football clubs, since its establishment in 1999. This is also the twelfth season of the league since its rebrand from J.League Division 2. == Overview == === General === This marked the first J2 League season scheduled with a summer-to-spring format with 20 teams will compete in the league – the fourteen teams from [[2025 J2 League|the previous season]], three teams relegated from the [[2025 J1 League|J1 League]] and three teams promoted from [[2025 J3 League|J3 League]]. === Teams relegated from J1 League === [[Yokohama F. Marinos]]' victory over [[Sanfrecce Hiroshima]] saw [[Albirex Niigata]] become the first team to be relegated on 25 October 2025. Albirex Niigata returned to J2 after spending three seasons in the top division. [[Shonan Bellmare]] became the second team to be relegated after losing to [[Avispa Fukuoka]] on 26 October 2025, as Shonan Bellmare returned to J2 after spending eight seasons in the top division.{{Cite web |date=27 October 2025 |title=J1 League Match Week 35 Recap: Niigata fight back to stun Kobe, Fukuoka relegate Shonan {{!}} News |url=https://www.jleague.co/news/j1-league-match-week-35-recap-niigata-fight-back-to-stun-kobe-fukuoka-relegate-shonan/ |access-date=19 April 2026 |website=J.LEAGUE |language=en}} [[Yokohama FC]] became the final team to be relegated after losing to [[Kashima Antlers]] on 8 November 2025, followed by Yokohama F. Marinos' victory over [[Kyoto Sanga FC|Kyoto Sanga]] the following day. Both results returned Yokohama FC to J2 after spending a season in the top division. === Teams promoted to J1 League === [[Mito HollyHock]] and [[V-Varen Nagasaki]] became the first two teams to be promoted on 29 November 2025. In the final matchweek, Mito HollyHock defeated [[Oita Trinita]] while V-Varen Nagasaki held [[Tokushima Vortis]] to a draw. This result ended a 25-season stay in J2 for Mito HollyHock and seven-seasons stay for V-Varen Nagasaki.{{Cite web |last=Sadhana |first=Cokorda Krishna |date=30 November 2025 |title=Mito Caps Fairytale Season with J2 Title Triumph |url=https://football-tribe.com/asia/2025/11/30/mito-caps-fairytale-season-with-j2-title-triumph/ |access-date=11 March 2026 |website=Football Tribe Asia |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |date=15 January 2026 |title=Mito, Nagasaki, and Chiba: Meet the trio of promoted sides that will be competing in the MEIJI YASUDA J1 100 YEAR VISION LEAGUE |url=https://www.jleague.co/id/news/mito-nagasaki-and-chiba-meet-the-trio-of-promoted-sides-that-will-be-competing-in-the-meiji-yasuda-j1-100-year-vision-league/ |access-date=11 March 2026 |website=J.LEAGUE |language=en}} The final promotion spot to J1 was secured by [[JEF United Chiba]] by defeating Tokushima Vortis in the final round of the promotion playoffs on 13 December 2025. This result saw them return to J1 after 17 seasons in the second division.{{Cite web |date=14 December 2025 |title=J1 Promotion Play-Offs Final Recap: Chiba achieve long-awaited return to top flight with win over Tokushima |url=https://www.jleague.co/news/j1-promotion-play-offs-final-recap-chiba-achieve-long-awaited-return-to-top-flight-with-win-over-tokushima/ |access-date=11 March 2026 |website=J.LEAGUE |language=en}} === Teams promoted from J3 League === [[Tochigi City FC|Tochigi City]] became the first team to be promoted on 23 November 2025 after defeating [[AC Nagano Parceiro|Nagano Parceiro]] in matchweek 37. This result made it their second consecutive promotion after previously being promoted from JFL to J3. [[Vanraure Hachinohe]] became the second team to be promoted by holding [[FC Ryukyu|Ryukyu Okinawa]] to a draw in the final matchweek on 29 November 2025. The last promotion slot secured by [[Tegevajaro Miyazaki]] after defeating [[FC Osaka]] in the final round of the promotion playoff on 14 December 2025.{{Cite web |title=栃木シティを応援いただくすべての皆さまへ |url=https://tochigi-city.com/new/2025/11/23/20251123001/ |website=Tochigi City FC |date=23 November 2025 |access-date=31 January 2026 |language=ja}}{{Cite web |last=|date=29 November 2025 |title=【11/29(土)琉球戦】試合結果・コメント - ヴァンラーレ八戸FCオフィシャルサイト |url=https://vanraure.net/archives/718784 |website=Vanraure Hachinohe |access-date=31 January 2026 |language=ja}}{{Cite web |title=祝 宮崎総力戦でJ2昇格！ - テゲバジャーロ宮崎－オフィシャルサイト |url=https://tegevajaro.com/news/476 |date=14 December 2025 |access-date=31 January 2026 |website=Tegevajaro Miyazaki |language=ja}} The three promoted teams will compete in J2 for the first time in their respective history. === Teams relegated to J3 League === [[Ehime FC]] became the first team to be relegated on 26 October 2025 after being defeated by [[Júbilo Iwata]] in matchweek 34 and that result ended their time in J2 for two seasons.{{Cite web |last=|date=26 October 2025 |title=愛媛FCを応援してくださるすべての皆様へ |url=https://ehimefc.com/topics/topic47619.html |access-date=29 January 2026 |website=Ehime FC|language=ja}} [[Kataller Toyama]]'s victory over [[Blaublitz Akita]] in the final matchweek on 29 November 2025, resulted in the relegation of [[Renofa Yamaguchi FC|Renofa Yamaguchi]] and [[Roasso Kumamoto]].
